profile.headline: Software Engineer | Technical Leadership
profile.summary:
I'm a Senior Software Engineer who enjoys solving ambiguous, high-impact problems. My work sits at the intersection of software engineering, data engineering, and product strategy, partnering closely with stakeholders to understand real world challenges and building scalable solutions from the ground up.

At Phoenix Mercury, I build full-stack applications and data pipelines that power basketball operations, working directly with coaching and front office staffs to translate complex workflows into practical technical solutions.

With a background in both engineering and technical project management, I naturally bridge technical and business teams, drive cross-functional initiatives, and take ownership from idea to production. I'm passionate about building products that solve meaningful problems and leveraging modern AI tools to move quickly without compromising quality.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Full-Stack Development · Data Engineering · Project Management · TypeScript · Python · NestJS · React.js · PostgreSQL · Snowflake · Cursor AI · Artificial Intelligence (AI)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
2U is an edTech company that contracts with non-profit colleges and universities to build, deliver and support online degree and non-degree programs. It is also the parent company of edX.

- I developed tools and infrastructure for capturing marketing lead data, managing React Content Management System to enable lead data capture form creation/management, and an event-driven data pipeline with AWS Lambda, SNS, and SQS.
positions.insights: Skills: Back-End Web Development · Front-End Development · Systems Design

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Houzz Pro is a SaaS platform for contractors and design professionals that provides lead and project management solutions.

- Built experience to connect homeowners with home improvement professionals
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Node.js · GraphQL · JavaScript · Docker

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Workiva is a global SaaS company that provides a cloud-based connected and reporting compliance platform that enables the use of connected data and automation of reporting across finance, accounting, risk, and compliance.

- Development of two new products from inception to GA:
- Processes: https://support.workiva.com/hc/en-us/articles/360047036512-Introduction-to-Processes
- Automations: https://support.workiva.com/hc/en-us/articles/4619353392532-Intro-to-automations

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
I was hired to build and lead Glooko’s localization efforts from the ground up. I developed and executed a comprehensive global expansion strategy, provided essential l10n/i18n best practices to UI/UX, Engineering, Product Management, and leadership teams, and established agreements with localization vendor to streamline processes. 

Additionally, I managed projects for software engineering teams, overseeing multiple concurrent launches with a team of ~15 engineers and PMs, ensuring each initiative was executed efficiently, on time, and within scope.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Software Project Management · Leadership · Localization · Internationalization · Agile Methodologies · Vendor Management

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description: While at Google, I led large-scale, cross-functional localization initiatives for the international launch of core products like Search, Maps, and Cloud across 70+ languages. I collaborated closely with Engineering, Product, and Marketing teams, directing comprehensive QA across Web, Android, and iOS platforms to ensure a high-quality, seamless user experience for a global audience. I also optimized localization processes and tools to enhance scalability and efficiency.
positions.insights: Skills: Leadership · Project Management · Localization · Cross-functional Collaborations · Quality Assurance Testing

positions.title: Localization Associate
positions.description: I conducted in-depth SEM/SEO research for the Korean market, using diverse resources and data to drive precise keyword optimization. My comprehensive Korean market analysis, presented to the Domain Manager and Director of International Business, played a decisive role in the company’s potential entry into the market.
positions.insights: Skills: Project Management · Data Analysis · Market Research · Google Analytics · Localization

positions.title: Customer-Facing Roles
positions.description:
- Cold-called prospects, led consultations, and conducted discovery sessions to identify needs and deliver tailored solutions.
- Increased customer engagement through social media strategy and direct interaction.
- Resolved customer issues and provided exceptional service.

projects.title: Pal-a-table
projects.description:
Social app
React | Redux | Node | Express | MongoDB | JWT | Passport | Socket.io | Heroku

- Worked as a Full Stack Software Engineer in a team of 3
- Architected the overall application structure and database schema design
- Designed the app mock up and user experience workflow
- Developed Profile and Restaurant Picker components

projects.title: Tarque
projects.description:
E-commerce app
PostgreSQL | Sequelize | MongoDB | Mongoose | Artillery | loader.io | New Relic | Docker | EC2 

- Worked as a Backend Software Engineer in a team of 4
- Benchmarked relational and non-relational database to optimize queries with 10M records
- Implemented partial indexing to achieve 97.5% optimization in Postgres’ query execution time
- Stress tested with Artillery and New Relic scaling from 1 to 1000 RPS, and achieved average latency of 7 ms
- Deployed microservice to AWS EC2
